title: Licensing and Brand Transactions
short: Licences, franchising, assignments, coexistence agreements and the trademark aspects of corporate transactions.
intro: A brand grows through other people: licensees, franchisees, distributors, joint venture partners and acquirers. Each arrangement transfers some of the control that keeps a trademark valid and valuable. We draft and negotiate the agreements that let a brand be shared without being lost, and we handle the trademark side of transactions where a brand changes hands.

Our drafting is informed by what happens when these agreements are tested, in a rectification petition alleging an uncontrolled licence, a dispute over who owns the goodwill in a territory, or an acquisition where the chain of title turns out to be broken.
services: Trademark licences, including quality control, royalty, audit and termination provisions that stand up to challenge
Franchise and master franchise agreements and brand standards manuals
Assignments and deeds of transfer, with recordal before the Registry
Coexistence, consent and settlement agreements that resolve conflicts without litigation
Trademark provisions in distribution, manufacturing, sponsorship and endorsement agreements
Brand aspects of mergers, acquisitions, demergers and investment rounds, including due diligence and chain of title
Security interests over trademarks and their recordal
Registered user applications and advice on permitted use under Section 48

process.title: Commercial understanding
process.text: We start with the deal, not the template: who controls what, where, for how long and at what price.

process.title: Structure
process.text: Advice on the ownership and licensing structure that protects the mark and fits the tax and corporate position.

process.title: Drafting and negotiation
process.text: Agreements drafted in plain terms and negotiated with the other side, with the client kept informed at each turn.

process.title: Recordal and follow-through
process.text: Assignments and licences recorded, and the client advised on the obligations the agreement creates.
